name: Lifeweave Artifacts
desc: Used by [The Hive](faction:the_hive), [Etrea](faction:etrea) wants to steal them for their own purpose. Mentioned in the book Lament of Cirryn, these artifacts were at one point sought after by Etrea, and they are currently continuing their efforts to steal them in [The Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley). The conflict can be seen in the Hive vs. Etrea event.
